title: Repair feature resources, resets, scaling, and selected feature capabilities
description:
Repair known feature/feat defects: source-governed resets, phantom resources, missing
use/scaling progression, option-local behavior, and specific source mechanics surfaced
by audits. Structured data must be source-faithful wherever emitted; deterministic
execution is required only for positive selected operations and state-integrity primitives.
design:
2026-10-09 DESIGN (Claude Captain, survey at main a961fb0b). Lane A, profile rules-clause-complete. mechanics.resources on features/traits is NOT consumed by any engine capability (class pools come from class-table columns via packages/core/src/state/classResources.ts), so this is source-fidelity projection only; no engine change.
ROOT CAUSE (one defect class): deriveFeatureMechanics (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts ~L5235-5285) emits resources:[{reset}] whenever the text merely CONTAINS 'short rest'/'long rest' (reset chosen by substring), and reads 'use this feature once|twice|three times' anywhere (so Indomitable's scaling sentence 'twice between long rests starting at 13th level' becomes uses:2). Shared by class/subclass features (emit.ts ~L910), feats (~L1016), ancestry traits (~L1539), background features (~L1599).
DECISION: emit a resource ONLY from a governing source relation that limits or restores uses: (a) 'you must finish a <R> before you can <use it|rage|do so> again' / 'you can't use <it|this feature> again until you <finish|complete> a <R>' / 'You must then finish a <R> to use your Channel Divinity again' / 'you can use it again after you finish a <R>'; (b) 'you regain <any|all> <of your>? expended uses <...> when you finish a <R>' / 'When you finish a <R>, you regain <all>? <your>? expended uses' / 'regain the ability to do so when you finish a <R>'; (c) pools: 'replenishes when you take a <R>', ki 'unavailable until you finish a <R>, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back'; (d) slots: 'You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a <R>' -> add resource:'spell-slots'. R in {short rest, long rest, short or long rest}; reset from the matched R, never from substring presence elsewhere. A rest mentioned only as a trigger/occasion (during a short rest, at the end of a long rest, can be done during a short rest, when you finish a short rest choose X, a DC/penalty counter that resets) yields NO resource.
USES: 'Once you use this feature'/(a)-forms with no count -> uses:1; 'You can use this feature twice' -> 2; 'a number of times equal to your <Ability> modifier (a minimum of once)' -> uses:'<ability>-modifier', usesMinimum:1; 'equal to 1 + your <Ability> modifier' -> uses:'1-plus-<ability>-modifier'; scaling sentences 'twice between rests starting at Nth level, three times ... Mth' / 'Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest' / 'Beginning at 6th level ... twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level ... three times' -> usesByLevel:[{level,uses}] starting at the feature's own level with its base count. A table-column pool (rage, ki, sorcery points) carries no uses.
EXPECTED (source-verified against each record's text; the regression oracle):
 keep/adjust: barbarian:rage {reset:long-rest}; bard:bardic-inspiration {uses:'charisma-modifier',usesMinimum:1,reset:long-rest}; bard:font-of-inspiration {reset:short-or-long-rest, appliesTo:'feature:bard:bardic-inspiration'}; bard|cleric|druid|paladin|ranger|sorcerer|wizard:spellcasting {resource:'spell-slots',reset:long-rest} UNIFORMLY (remove RESOURCE_PROJECTION_WITHHELD_PENDING_F05 + withheldResources in emit.ts ~L884-898); warlock:pact-magic {resource:'spell-slots',reset:short-or-long-rest}; circle-of-the-land:natural-recovery {uses:1,reset:long-rest} (F-05); cleric:channel-divinity {usesByLevel:[{2,1},{6,2},{18,3}],reset:short-or-long-rest}; paladin:sacred-oath {uses:1,reset:short-or-long-rest}; druid:wild-shape {uses:2,reset:short-or-long-rest}; fighter:action-surge {usesByLevel:[{2,1},{17,2}],reset:short-or-long-rest}; fighter:indomitable {usesByLevel:[{9,1},{13,2},{17,3}],reset:long-rest} (F-03); fighter:second-wind, rogue:stroke-of-luck, the-fiend:dark-ones-own-luck {uses:1,reset:short-or-long-rest}; oath-of-devotion:holy-nimbus, the-fiend:hurl-through-hell, warlock:eldritch-master, way-of-the-open-hand:wholeness-of-body {uses:1,reset:long-rest}; monk:ki {reset:short-or-long-rest}; paladin:cleansing-touch {uses:'charisma-modifier',usesMinimum:1,reset:long-rest}; paladin:divine-sense {uses:'1-plus-charisma-modifier',reset:long-rest} (F-24); paladin:lay-on-hands {reset:long-rest}; warlock:mystic-arcanum {uses:1,reset:long-rest} (per arcanum spell, prose keeps that); wizard:signature-spells {uses:1,reset:short-or-long-rest}; wizard:arcane-recovery {uses:1,reset:'day'} (F-04: 'Once per day when you finish a short rest' - the use window is per day; add 'day' to the validated reset vocabulary with a doc comment; the short-rest occasion stays prose); ancestry traits dragonborn Breath Weapon, half-orc Relentless Endurance {uses:1,reset as now}; tiefling Infernal Legacy {reset:long-rest} unchanged.
 REMOVE (phantom, F-06): barbarian:relentless-rage (DC counter), bard:song-of-rest (occasion), school-of-evocation:overchannel (escalating-damage counter, uses unlimited), sorcerer:sorcerous-restoration (partial regain of 4 points; a full-reset entry would be false; font-of-magic's procedure pool already carries long-rest reset), the-fiend:fiendish-resilience (occasion), warlock:pact-boon (ritual occasion), way-of-the-open-hand:tranquility (occasion), cleric:divine-intervention (reset is conditional: 7 days if the deity intervened, else long rest; a flat long-rest entry is false; leave to prose).
 font-of-magic unchanged (procedure pool). Any record outside this table whose resources change must be source-checked and reported (stop if unexplained).
F-12 (ki-abilities, 'Ki abilities and save DC are structured'): project ONLY the ki save DC via the existing saveDcFormula effect by extending its grammar to the printed form '<X> save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your <Ability> modifier' ({kind:'saveDcFormula',base:8,ability:'wisdom',addProficiencyBonus:true}); siblings using the same printed form (Spell save DC lines in spellcasting features) incidentally gain it - verify and list them. Ki feature costs (Flurry/Patient Defense/Step of the Wind) stay verbatim prose: no capability consumes them; ki pool accounting is classResources' table pool with DM-declared spend. Registry: ki-abilities -> 'narrowed' with that reasoning.
indep:003 (class-feature-completeness, 'Class features and feats retain complete procedures'): -> 'narrowed': ADR 0020 withdraws completeness; surviving obligation = emitted structured feature data is source-faithful (this repair) and feature prose remains verbatim discoverable.
F-03/F-04/F-05/F-06/F-24 rows: keep 'accepted' (owner repaired them); add statusReasoning naming this PR and the evidence.
EVIDENCE: replace keyword-based expectations with ONE generalized invariant over the real committed pack: for every record/trait carrying mechanics.resources, the record text contains a governing relation sentence whose rest matches the entry's reset (checked by an independent predicate in the test, not the importer's own function), plus a table-driven assertion of the EXPECTED map above (exact source-fidelity regressions for the named findings F-03/F-04/F-05/F-06/F-24), plus a negative: no resource on the REMOVE list. Do not add one test per feature beyond that table.
acceptance_criteria:
- Reset semantics cannot be created from keyword presence without the governing source relation.
- Known phantom resources are removed with source-grounded regressions.
- Known use-count/die/progression losses are represented accurately where projected.
- Pack data consumed by a capability in force is source-faithful; that capability's contract, execution, and state evidence belong to the capability lane (eshyra-o9bd.19.5 / eshyra-olc5).
- Unmodeled/model-adjudicated feature semantics remain discoverable source material, not implied green or an automatic engine gap.
